title: Museum entry announcement
passage: Welcome to the Harbor Museum. The special photography exhibition is on the second floor, while the permanent collection remains on the ground floor. Your general admission ticket includes both areas today. The guided tour of the photography exhibition begins at two fifteen beside the main staircase. Large bags must be left in the lockers near the entrance. You may take photographs without flash, except where a sign indicates otherwise. The cafe will close at four, one hour before the museum.
passageZh: 歡迎來到 Harbor 博物館。攝影特展位於二樓，常設展仍在一樓。今天的一般門票包含兩個展區。攝影展導覽於兩點十五分在主樓梯旁開始。大型包包必須寄放在入口附近的置物櫃。除另有標示之處外，可以拍照但不能使用閃光燈。咖啡廳四點打烊，比博物館早一小時。
